fields.note: Phase row: the Apertura, one half of the split season. After CONCACAF asked the LPF to return to the European calendar, the 2026 Apertura (24 July – 5 December) opens the 2026–27 season; the previous 'Clausura 2025' was a transition tournament. Not a calendar-year January start.
Phase row: the Apertura final is played on 5 December 2026 (single match at the Rommel Fernández). The Clausura is a separate phase in 2027.
